_comment: The two artifact identities the Qwen lane is pinned to, recorded when they were built rather than when they are used. A digest written down at deploy time is a claim; one written down at build time is a fact. Nothing here attests the loaded runtime — that is Stage 3's job, from the GPU, and until it happens the output budgets remain candidate measurements and qwen_overlay stays off.

model.commit_marker: COMMITTED.json written last, after every artifact and the manifest

serving_image.tag_defect: The commit component was empty: CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION is unset under NO_SOURCE, and the fallback guard tested the whole tag rather than the component, so it could never fire. Fixed in the buildspec. The image CONTENT is unaffected — serve.py was fetched from WRITTEN_SOURCE_COMMIT, which was set correctly.
serving_image.content_equals_head: serve.py is byte-identical between 73a1dab and 97da981; the only commit between them touched the weights buildspec.
serving_image.bundled_cuda_runtime: nvidia-*-cu12 12.8.x, on a CUDA 12.4 base image — the wheel ships its own runtime, so this is expected, and it is exactly what the Stage 3 load attestation must confirm against the host driver rather than assume.

not_yet_true: No GPU endpoint exists. Service quota L-B0729CB4 (ml.g6e.xlarge for endpoint usage) reads 0, request for 2 still PENDING.
The loaded runtime is unattested; no release_manifests row names these digests.
qwen_overlay is off and no invocation has ever been recorded.

gateway_image.note: Deployed and verified. Health and attestation answer; no model transport is configured, so it cannot call anything.
